description: A Flutter state management controller class 'NotesController' responsible for managing notes, interfacing with a notes repository, and notifying widgets of state changes.

classes.name: NotesController
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier subclass that manages notes data, loading state, search, sorting, and provides methods for modifying notes.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously loads notes from the repository into memory, handling loading state and errors.

methods.name: setSearchQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query string and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setPinnedFirst
methods.description: Updates the sorting preference to pin notes first and notifies listeners.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reloads notes based on current filters.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Creates a new note via the repository and reloads the notes list.

methods.name: updateExisting
methods.description: Updates an existing note via the repository and reloads the list.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID via the repository and reloads the list.
